steps.name: prompt-cache
steps.summary: I-155 fixed: after a learned-kiosk command answers pending, the next call of the request waits for the bridge (runChat polls the store, the voice runner reads the latest streamed session; 200 ms polls up to 12 s, src/lib/agent/bridgeWait.ts), else the rest get the server's CONFLICT 'kiosk still working' without being sent. Explicit Gemini context cache for the text agent (src/lib/agent/cache.ts): chatInstructions splits a static system (rules+menu, same per kiosk/locale) from a <current_order> block prepended to the latest user message; one cache per backend/model/prompt hash, 60 min TTL, replaced 5 min before expiry, refused create -> inline + one log line + 10 min backoff, cached call 400/403/404 -> drop + inline once; Live unchanged (LiveConnectConfig has no cachedContent). Measured (evidence/prompt-cache.json): text hero order $0.0588 -> $0.0088 before storage (85% less; 77,048 of 79,593 prompt tokens cached; reorder alone $0.0556), storage price not on file (unverified, break-even $5.19/1M tok/h at 1 order/cache-hour); eval 44/44 before, 44/44 after (14/14 on API key, then key hit HTTP 402 -> I-104 reopened, voice down until credits topped up; 30/30 re-run on Vertex, cache works there too, refused for small Doughhouse prompt); no latency gain (same 18 requests: median 6.4->6.7 s, first command 2.6->3.9 s). Kept for cost. Docs: TESTING ledger, ARCHITECTURE limits, DECK_FACTS cost rows, ISSUE I-155/I-104. AC: lint, build, test 806 passed, eval:agent, measure:cost.

steps.name: load-check
steps.summary: scripts/load-check.ts (npm run load:check, tsx --env-file=.env): starts the local standalone production server (node .next/standalone/server.js as on Cloud Run; next start warns with output: standalone) on a free 127.0.0.1 port with STORE=memory ALLOW_MEMORY_STORE=1 GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=auto, memory/handle probe via NODE_OPTIONS --import scripts/load-probe.mjs, never a deployed URL; each simulated /demo user = 13 requests (demo session, 2 held SSE streams, 2 pings, setDineOption, hero adds, updateCart fries L, requestCheckout, confirmCheckout button, cardAction stand-in); `-- --no-chat` dry run. Results (evidence/load-check.json, phases/11-hardening/LOAD.md): own addresses 5/10/20 users all paid, command p50 <=12 ms p90 <=24 ms, SSE event 0-1 ms after response (memory store), RSS peak <=130 MB, open handles back to idle 2 after each scenario (no leak), closed streams release their per-IP places. 5 real /api/chat in parallel: all 2 hero lines but 25.4-39.8 s each (key 402 -> Vertex fallback; new I-157 P1, slow-text-agent 3rd -> R-011 proposed). Shared address: 5 users -> 1/5 paid, 4 refused at confirm/pay by 60 req/min; 20 users -> 10 sessions/min first, then 10 streams, then 60/min; all polite JSON 429, health 200 (I-154 updated). Recommendation: keep concurrency 80/max 3; raise per-IP limit for token-bearing requests (not changed, needs real /demo voice request rate); fix I-033; top up key and re-run. No limits changed, no product code changed.

steps.name: lighthouse
steps.summary: scripts/lighthouse.ts (npm run lighthouse -- --label <name>; plain node, not tsx, whose __name helper breaks Lighthouse's in-page code): local standalone production build with public/ and .next/static copied as the Dockerfile does, STORE=memory, Playwright's Chromium, Lighthouse 13.5.0 (devDependency), median of 3 loads; pages / desktop+mobile, /demo desktop, /assistant mobile (claimed from a fresh QR link), /kiosk desktop; evidence/lighthouse.json keeps before and after (scores, failed audits, observed LCP, transfer), HTML reports in phases/11-hardening/qa/ (git-ignored). Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO 100 on every page before and after. Performance before -> after: / desktop 84->100, / mobile 75->98, /demo 82->100, /assistant 67->88, /kiosk 81->99. Cause (I-158, fixed): next/font preloaded 187 IBM Plex Sans KR slices on every page (188-195 font files, ~1.6 MB of 2.0-2.2 MB); fix preload:false + drop unused weight 500 (src/app/layout.tsx) -> 3-17 font files, 0.39-0.46 MB per page, /kiosk observed LCP 2.6 s -> 0.42 s, Korean still in Plex. Landing and D1 pictures now resized by next/image with sizes (no unoptimized), hero fetchPriority high. Left open (I-159): /assistant renders its text after hydration (simulated LCP 3.8 s, observed 0.29 s), ~70 KB unused Next JS, 14 KB polyfills, 38 KB render-blocking font CSS. TESTING ledger and README evidence rows added. AC: lint, build, test 806 passed, test:e2e 19 passed/14 @live skipped, qa:ui 26 passed; evidence/touch-hero.json and bridge-replay.json rewritten by test:e2e were restored by hand (I-099).
